title: Western Popoloca language - Wikipedia
text: Western Popoloca is an indigenous language of Puebla state, Mexico. There are two principal varieties, sometimes counted as distinct languages, which are about 75% mutually intelligible. Approximately half of ethnic Popoloca of these towns speak the language. Sounds [p, r] only occur from loanwords. [2] Williams, Ann F.; Pike, Eunice V. (1968).
